verdict.rationale: smolagents is an open-source Python library, so data portability is a fair question, and the evidence points to several open exit paths. Agent runs are instrumented with the OpenTelemetry standard (docs-10). Agent memory is directly accessible in code (docs-21). Agents and tools can be pushed to and pulled from Hub repositories (gh-3, gh-10). Model choice is not locked to any provider (gh-1). However, none of the evidence describes a dedicated 'export all data' feature or names file formats for memory and run history; leaving relies on the user writing their own export code. Missing for 10: a documented one-step export of all agent data (memory, run history, configs), named open file formats for that export, and independent or hands-on confirmation of a clean exit.
